) is the debut studio album by South Korean singer-songwriter
Youra
. The album was released on 7 July 2023.
[
2
]
Background
(1)
started from the dream that Yu-ra had one day, and completed by collecting various landscapes and thoughts that follow between reality and fantasy. She said of her musical philosophy, "I will deal with minor lingering feelings, compassion, and scents in producing songs in the future."
[
3
]
Critical reception
Professional ratings
Review scores
Source
Rating
IZM
[
4
]
Park Soojin of
IZM
said "
(1)
is a free and rich record, like adding listeners' interpretation to an empty space."
[
4
]
Jung Byeongwook of
Music Y
described the track
Motif
(
구운듯한 얼굴이 너의 모티프
) as "It is a punk in 2023, which evokes the stage of
Patti Smith
, whose French symbolic poetry blends with the intense Garage band sound."
[
5
]
Music critic Seojeongmingab reviewed "The music, which is so spontaneous that it should be called jazz, creates a dreamlike beauty by coordinating with the fantasy world in the lyrics that capture the moment. This is why this album acquires value and meaning."

6
